content.content:
Summarize this email in one or two plain sentences for someone triaging their inbox: what the
sender wants or is telling them, and any action or deadline. No preamble, no greeting, no bullet
points — just the summary.

FROM: bob@known.example.com
SUBJECT: Contract review Thursday

Can you review the draft contract before our Thursday call? I need your comments on section 4 by Wednesday evening.

response.text: Bob is asking you to review a draft contract and provide comments on section 4 by Wednesday evening before a Thursday call.
